title: Reverse Singly Linked List
problem: Given the head of a singly linked list, reverse the list, and return the reversed list. Node is object with val and next attributes.
constraints:
The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5000].
-5000 <= Node.val <= 5000
hints: Maintain pointers to prev, curr, and next node.
code:
def solution(head):
    prev = None
    curr = head
    while curr:
        nxt = curr.next
        curr.next = prev
        prev = curr
        curr = nxt
    return prev
